entities.name: PMID:22079733
observations: In 20 patients with early unfavorable mediastinal Hodgkin lymphoma, INRT reduced planning target volume versus IFRT (1015 vs 1705 cm³) while maintaining nearly identical target mean dose.
INRT lowered almost all evaluated heart, lung, breast, and spinal-cord dose-volume parameters by approximately 20%-50% with both 3D-RT and IMRT.

entities.name: PMID:25082095
observations: In 17 pediatric Hodgkin lymphoma patients, virtual INRT plans produced significantly lower mean doses to kidneys, heart, thyroid, parotids, and lungs than original IFRT plans (p<0.05).
INRT also reduced breast volume receiving at least 50% of prescription dose.

entities.name: PMID:36896214
observations: Modern GHSG HD16/HD17 quality-assurance data found INRT feasible without deterioration in overall radiotherapy quality and associated with improved thyroid doses.
The indexed abstract did not provide a complete paired INRT-versus-IFRT dose-volume table.

entities.name: INRT OAR sparing
observations: Direct comparative planning studies generally show lower critical-organ doses with INRT than IFRT, especially in mediastinal Hodgkin lymphoma.
The evidence is dosimetric and retrospective; benefit depends on accurate reconstruction of initially involved sites and adequate target coverage.
